name: Merchant-of-record billing migration
problem_statement: Migrate a SaaS app's payments from a payment-processor integration to a merchant-of-record provider so the platform no longer handles sales tax, VAT, or chargebacks directly. Cover the webhook signature verification, idempotent credit grants, refund reversals, and a reconciliation job.
recency_rationale: Merchant-of-record providers, their webhook signing schemes, and tax-handling guarantees change frequently; current docs and SDK names are recency-sensitive and benefit from live grounding.

name: FastAPI server-sent-events streaming service
problem_statement: Build a FastAPI service that streams long-running LLM generations to a browser over Server-Sent Events, with a watchdog that keeps the connection alive during silent reasoning, idempotent resume, and graceful client-disconnect handling under async SQLAlchemy.
recency_rationale: FastAPI, Starlette, and async SQLAlchemy streaming idioms shift across releases; grounding can surface the current recommended patterns and deprecations.

name: Multi-provider LLM gateway
problem_statement: Design a unified gateway that routes generation requests across multiple frontier LLM providers, normalizing streaming token deltas, reasoning/thinking deltas, tool-use, and usage accounting behind one interface, with per-provider model catalogs and cost estimation.
recency_rationale: Frontier model identifiers, context windows, pricing, and streaming event shapes change on a monthly cadence; this is the strongest case for live grounding to help.

name: OAuth 2.1 PKCE flow for a SPA
problem_statement: Implement a secure Google sign-in flow for a single-page app using the current OAuth 2.1 best practices: PKCE, short-lived access tokens held in memory, refresh tokens in HTTP-only cookies, and CSRF protection on all mutating requests.
recency_rationale: OAuth best-current-practice guidance (token storage, implicit-flow deprecation, PKCE) has evolved; grounding can confirm the current recommendations.

name: Retrieval-augmented search backend
problem_statement: Build a retrieval-augmented search backend over a Postgres database using pgvector for embeddings, hybrid lexical-plus-semantic ranking, chunking with overlap, and a re-ranking pass, exposed as an async API with caching.
recency_rationale: pgvector capabilities, index types, and hybrid-search recommendations change across versions; current guidance is recency-sensitive.

name: Team task tracker (recency-neutral control)
problem_statement: Build a collaborative task tracker where teams create projects, add tasks with assignees and due dates, comment, and see an activity feed. Standard CRUD over a relational database with role-based access control.
recency_rationale: Deliberate control case: a well-trodden CRUD problem where current web context should add little. Grounding is expected to be neutral here, which validates that the off/on comparison does not spuriously favor grounding.
